NFL fines 49ers’ Juszczyk for chugging celebration

Posted on September 24, 2026September 25, 2026 by Santiago Leon
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers fullback Kyle Juszczyk $14,926 for pretending to chug a beer during a Week 2 victory over the Miami Dolphins, according to a letter from the league obtained by ESPN’s Adam Schefter.

“Your imitation of chugging a beer constituted an offensive demonstration and could reasonably be construed as being in poor taste,” the NFL wrote.

This is the first time Juszczyk has been disciplined for the celebration, which he’s been doing since entering the NFL, Schefter added.
